```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__pshaTabReflowInstalled) return;
  window.__pshaTabReflowInstalled = true;

  function fireSlideEnter() {
    var event = document.createEvent("Event");
    event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
    document.dispatchEvent(event);
  }

  function reflowHighcharts() {
    if (!window.Highcharts || !Highcharts.charts) return;
    Highcharts.charts.forEach(function (chart) {
      if (chart && chart.renderTo && chart.renderTo.offsetParent !== null) {
        chart.reflow();
      }
    });
  }

  function scheduleReflow() {
    [0, 100, 300].forEach(function (delay) {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        fireSlideEnter();
        reflowHighcharts();
      }, delay);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("tabby", scheduleReflow, true);
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", scheduleReflow);
})();
</script>
```
